player_prompt.intro:
Ozali Joueur {player_id} na SimpleTak.
Na mbeta, libanga nayo ezali '{player_stone}' mpe libanga ya mpangi nayo ezali '{opponent_stone}'.

Na ntango nayo, chagua seli ya libele (na numero yake) mpe weka libanga nayo kuna.
Kwa mfano, '[12]' weka libanga nayo na seli 12.

Lelo nayo ezali kofunga njia ya libanga nayo inaunganisha mbili ya kingo za mbeta (juu-mwamba au kushoto-kulia).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: Lolenge ya kobaluka ezali malamu te
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Motango ya cellule oyo ezali na ntina te {cell_num}. Esengeli kozala kati 0 mpe {max_board_num} .
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Celle {cell_num} eza déjà occupé. Pona cellule moko ya pamba.

action.placement: Mokeli {current_player_id} akomaki simba na ye ({symbol}) na seli {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Mokeli {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') akomaki pamo na pili ya makala!
outcome.draw: Lisano etondi, mpe moto nyonso akómi na ngámbo moko!
